{{Quote|We've been so successful in raiding Imperial convoys that Moff Andal got another ship. The Star Destroyer ''Brazen''.|Melx, to Jacob Nive|<ref name="Operation: Elrood (book)">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>}}
'''Melx''' was a fair-haired [[Gender/Legends|male]] youth who was a member of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jacob Nive]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Survivors raided [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and in response, the Empire dispatched the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]'' to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Melx subsequently made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''[[Backstab]]'', a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by Nive, to inform Nive of the ''Brazen''{{'s}} deployment.
